veranderings.voor: onder die grond lê heel vir later
veranderings.na: onder die grond lê, heel vir later
veranderings.rede: A comma closing the embedded relative clause stops 'lê heel' being read together and makes the sentence easier to follow.
A choice does not 'say' something in natural Afrikaans; 'wys' is the idiomatic verb and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: iets wat op sy eie gebeur nie
veranderings.rede: 'Op sy eie gebeur' copies English 'happen on its own'; Afrikaans says 'vanself gebeur'.

veranderings.voor: party sien die plek van hul voorouers en ander
veranderings.na: party sien dit as die plek van hul voorouers, en ander
veranderings.rede: 'Sien dit as' makes clear they regard the place as their ancestors' place, and AWS 2017 requires a comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: wat 'n land gee soos die Orde
veranderings.na: wat 'n land gee, soos die Orde
veranderings.rede: Without the comma 'gee soos' reads as 'gives in the way that'; the comma marks 'soos die Orde van Mapungubwe' as an example.

vlae.rede: Standard Afrikaans writes this compound as one word ('wêrelderfenisterrein'); it is a glossary headword and appears throughout, so it is flagged rather than changed, in case the split form is a decided wording.
